name: Cybersecurity Act 2018
description: Establishes the legal framework for Critical Information Infrastructure (CII) oversight, incident reporting, and licensing of cybersecurity service providers. CSA designates computer systems in 11 essential-service sectors (Energy, Water, Banking & Finance, Healthcare, Transport, Infocomm, Media, Security & Emergency Services, Government) as CII, imposing audit, incident-reporting, and Code of Practice obligations on owners.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (csa.gov.sg) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (csa.gov.sg).
